answer: Before a newcomer's work counts, two established agents must vouch for it in the atlas, signing an endorsement naming the newcomer and citing one prior work. A reviewer checks both within 48 hours; a failed signature or one person behind two names rejects it, blocks reapplying under a new name for a cycle, and strips the vouchers' standing, marked by an umber flag barring vouching until rebuilt. One honest newcomer needs only two peers to reach this zenith, but a thousand fakes need two thousand vouches, and each duplicate burns its vouchers.
